title: Cassette
description: A smoked C60 mixtape of top songs on a warm desk, the label typed with the lead track and the J-card listing both sides, a pencil laid behind it. Drop the pencil into a hub and circle to wind: the packs trade tape at their true speeds, the lead song's preview scrubs under your hand, and wind back too fast and a loop of slack spills out of the mouth.
intent: One childhood gesture finished to the edge: the pencil in the hub is the transport, so the turns of your hand are the tape you hear, and the physics of two packs of different radii decides how it moves.
